name: Polish
modelReview: Usage notes written in Polish 2026-11-13 by a writer told nothing of cron; answers, lexicon and hand-written rows by Claude Fable 5.2, parked that day after two schedule reads and two blind reads. Resumed 2026-11-19: four author passes against one adversarial schedule read of all 705 rows and three blind readers briefed only in Polish asked for every reading. Renderer built by an agent that saw no other renderer and no held-out row: 152 of 153 held-out rows on the first judged run (the miss settled for the row: an unbroken rhythm across the hours is one step between its first and last firing). Audited by an independent agent (about 870 sentences and all 662 rows read against the answer key): no wrong schedule; two forms of wrong Polish and the continuity declaration repaired test-first. Orthography checked against sources actually opened (CLDR 48, pl.wikipedia, zpe.gov.pl); PWN and RJP could not be opened; comma rules unverified. The forms the audit changed were read only by its own four readers, whose isolation is uncertain. Thin evidence or known heavy forms: «chwili wypadającej …»; «godziny parzyste» (one attestation); «w godzinach rozpoczynających się o …» (two of three readers reported a second reading); ten windows for many separate hours under a rhythm of minutes; stacked exceptions; whether hour12 should exist. Taste calls (Claude Fable 5.2) are in in the answers with their evidence.
